record.question: A Superintendent of Police attends the wedding of his cousin (a near relative). The cousin's father gifts him a wristwatch worth 48,000. The relative has no official dealings with him. The SP does not report this gift, believing it is permissible as a customary gift. Which statement is correct?
options: He has violated the rules because no gifts may be accepted from near relatives
He has not violated the rules because gifts from near relatives are fully exempt
He must report the gift since it exceeds 25,000
He needs sanction from Government to accept a gift exceeding 1,500
